# Vast.ai

Search Vast.ai GPU compute offers, storage volume offers, and launch templates using a durable API key.

Category: Security & Ops. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/vast-ai/.

## Actions

- **Search GPU Offers** (read-only): Find currently rentable Vast.ai GPU compute offers using verified marketplace filters.
- **Search Templates** (read-only): Search Vast.ai launch templates by safe identifying metadata.
- **Search Volume Offers** (read-only): Find Vast.ai storage volume offers available in the marketplace.
